title: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship
program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver awarded with admission
duration: Scholarships are granted for the normative period of study: three years full-time for a bachelor's degree and two years full-time for a master's degree
description: The Aalto University Excellence Scholarship is a merit-based tuition fee waiver awarded to a very limited number of applicants who are liable to pay Aalto's English-taught programme tuition fees. The waiver covers 100% of the tuition fee for the normative period of study and does not cover living costs, which Aalto puts at a minimum of EUR 800 per month. The scholarship is applied for through the same application form as the degree programme, inside the programme's application period, and the decision is issued together with the admission decision.

title: University of Helsinki Scholarship Programme (tuition fee waivers)
program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver, 50% or 100%, decided with the admission result
duration: Two years; students must study full time and earn at least 55 ECTS per year, and after the first study year progress is checked before the scholarship is continued
description: The University of Helsinki scholarship programme consists of tuition fee waivers of 50% or 100% of the programme tuition fee for master's applicants from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are liable to pay tuition fees. Most awards are only 50%, and only a very limited number of waivers exist, so the competition is severe. The university states plainly that it does not offer scholarships to cover living expenses. The waiver is applied for with the same application form as the master's programme and takes effect only after a scholarship agreement is signed.

title: University of Turku Merit Scholarship and Early Bird Discount
program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver awarded during studies, plus an automatic first-year tuition discount
duration: One academic year at a time; the merit scholarship is awarded for the following academic year and must be reapplied for
description: Since the 2026 intake the University of Turku no longer offers a scholarship that covers the first year of tuition. Instead it offers an automatic EUR 2,000 Early Bird discount to newly admitted master's students who accept the offer and pay within 28 days of the admission decision, and the University of Turku Merit Scholarship, which covers 50% of the tuition fee for the following study year. title: LUT Scholarship and Early Bird Discount (master's studies)
program_type: Automatic tuition fee discount and merit/study-progress tuition scholarship
duration: The early bird discount applies to the first academic year and the LUT scholarship to the second academic year of a two-year master's programme
description: LUT University reduces tuition for fee-paying students of its two-year master's programmes in two automatic steps.
